summary: Iteration 2 testing on new features. Backend: 28/31 pytest tests pass. CRITICAL: PUT /api/sessions/{id}/times endpoint is NOT implemented in server.py — the SessionTimeUpdate Pydantic model is defined (line 93-95) but no route handler exists, so all calls return 404. This breaks (a) the History edit-times modal in reports.tsx (saveEdit) and (b) the dashboard quick-adjust buttons (-5/-15/-30/-60 min) in index.tsx. All other new endpoints work: GET /api/reports?period=year (200), GET /api/reports/rooms?period=today|week|month|year|all returns 16 room rows with all required fields. Frontend: All testIDs present and screens render correctly — period selector shows 5 options (today/week/month/year/all), 3 sub-tabs (ملخص/حسب الغرفة/السجل), 16 ranked rooms in rooms tab, history rows are tappable and open edit modal with start/end inputs + save button.

critical.issue: Route handler is completely missing in server.py. Pydantic model SessionTimeUpdate is defined at line 93 but no @api_router.put('/sessions/{session_id}/times') exists. Returns 404 'Not Found' for every call. This breaks both edit-session-times modal (reports.tsx saveEdit) and the 4 quick-adjust buttons in dashboard active-session modal (-5/-15/-30/-60 min).

issues: Same deprecation warnings noted in iter_1 still present (shadow*, props.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only.

action_items: ADD missing route in /app/backend/server.py: @api_router.put('/sessions/{session_id}/times', response_model=Session) async def update_session_times(session_id: str, body: SessionTimeUpdate). It must: (1) find session by id (404 if not found), (2) validate started_at/ended_at via datetime.fromisoformat (catch ValueError → raise HTTPException(400, 'صيغة وقت غير صحيحة')), (3) update started_at and/or ended_at fields, (4) recompute via compute_play_cost using new started_at and (ended_at if status=='closed' or provided ended_at)  → update elapsed_minutes, play_cost, total_cost (= play_cost + cafeteria_cost) in Mongo, (5) return updated Session. Without this fix, the edit-times modal AND all 4 quick-adjust buttons are broken end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines class SessionTimeUpdate(BaseModel) at line 93 but never references it — clear sign the route was forgotten.
compute_play_cost helper already accepts an optional ended_at_iso, so the fix is straightforward and mirrors stop_session logic.
Frontend (reports.tsx & index.tsx) is correctly wired: api.updateSessionTimes posts to /sessions/{id}/times with started_at and optional ended_at — fix is purely backend.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: server.py is missing the PUT /api/sessions/{session_id}/times route handler. The Pydantic request body model SessionTimeUpdate is defined (lines 93-95) but no @api_router.put decorator was added. REPRODUCTION: curl -X PUT $URL/api/sessions/anything/times -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' → HTTP 404 {"detail":"Not Found"}. MITIGATION: Add the missing route handler that updates started_at/ended_at and recomputes elapsed_minutes/play_cost/total_cost using the existing compute_play_cost helper. ~20 lines of code.
